common:
User priority clarification: FIRST deliver a fully working, tested project on the test network; the user will polish afterward. This supersedes prioritizing public-launch readiness or cosmetic polish as the current completion gate, and does not reduce the required functional scope to an MVP. Work directly in this existing visible T3 thread on Sol High, no subagents/new threads. Preserve active work, repository ownership, artifacts, device/session/worktree/Metro assignments and functional security/recovery safeguards.

Use the already-selected BCH Chipnet for shared CashTokens/CashScript integration. Verify actual chain/checkpoint and cross-project network agreement; bchtest prefixes or protocol chain labels alone cannot distinguish Chipnet from other BCH test networks. Do not silently switch testnet3/testnet4/regtest or relabel regtest evidence as live Chipnet. Local unit/VM/regtest tests support, but do not replace, actual network and browser/native journeys.

Prioritize code and end-to-end user journeys, usable functional UI, recovery and interoperable integrations. Defer cosmetic polish, marketing, store publication, unrelated competitor features and public-launch-only infrastructure that does not block this testnet delivery. Keep essential auth/privacy/approval/chain checks. Earlier no-broadcast/testnet-provisioning restrictions from coordinator briefs are superseded narrowly by this explicit testnet testing request: necessary isolated testnet setup and bounded test transactions with dedicated project-owned test identities/test coins may proceed through the normal approval flow. Never use mainnet or pre-existing user wallets/funds, bypass required human approvals (including physical iPhone confirmation), publish a product/package, push protected refs or merge. Secret inputs go through request_secret; no seeds/passwords in chat/logs/repos. Testnet faucet CAPTCHA remains user-controlled.

Inspect existing state before mutation; never retry ambiguous submissions automatically. Keep exact bytes/txid and reconcile independently. Do not bypass device claims or enable T3 agent-device integration. Browser work uses each thread's own T3 preview tabs. Shared endpoint provisioning belongs to indexer; avoid duplicate nodes/full-chain downloads. If live endpoint, test wallet/session, verified checkpoint or owned device is unavailable, pursue safe available setup and independent implementation; report the exact essential missing input instead of claiming completion.

Update RELEASE-STATUS/WORK-STATUS with testnetFunctionalReady=false until all required journeys are actually evidenced. Record exact network, revision/artifact, commands, test identities/public txids/confirmation state, recovery/error evidence and reproduction steps without secrets. publicReleaseReady remains separate/false. At a meaningful verified milestone or real prerequisite blocker, notify the existing coordinator as before. Do not restart/discard current work merely to rewrite documentation.
